title: Torque Wrench with Extension
introduction:
I use this drawing to check the tool arrangement before tightening: the wrench handle extends across the page, while the attachment leading to the socket sits at a right angle to it. Match the depicted relationship between the wrench and attachment, rather than treating any accessory called an extension as the same setup.

The drawing is the seating plan; the fastener’s workshop entry supplies the tightening target. Pair them before using the wrench. This is a setup reference, not a complete tightening procedure or a correction formula for other attachment angles. The adjacent instruction remains the authority for choosing the fastener specification.

items.name: Fastener-specific workshop information
items.detail: Identify the applicable fastener entry and its stated units before selecting the wrench setting.

items.name: Illustrated wrench arrangement
items.detail: Use the drawing to compare the torque wrench, attachment and socket relationship.
